title: The Hard Contact
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Ivo Thackeray, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
